text:
Sapporo in winter is magical, and slippery: the pavements freeze from mid-December to February. Save this 4-step checklist before you book, built from Sapporo's own tourism office and JR Hokkaido 👇

1️⃣ BOOK NEAR AN UNDERGROUND ENTRANCE

Sapporo Station, Odori and Susukino are linked underground, so a hotel close to an entrance means less walking on ice.

2️⃣ PACK BOOTS WITH GRIP

The tourism office says pavements freeze from mid-December to February. Take small steps with your weight low. Anti-slip spikes are sold at most convenience stores.

3️⃣ TAP SUICA AT THE AIRPORT

The Rapid Airport train needs no reservation for most seats (only car 4 is reserved). It's 33 minutes to Sapporo at the fastest, ¥1,230.

4️⃣ CHECK YOUR DATES AGAINST THE SNOW FESTIVAL

4 to 11 February 2027, in Odori Park and along Susukino's main street. Those areas fill first, so if you're going that week, book early and pick a flexible rate.

💬 OUR TAKE

For a first winter trip, Odori: about 10 minutes underground to the JR station and one stop to the jingisukan grills of Susukino.
